description: This file defines the Upload controller class within the Opencart admin area. It handles functionalities related to file uploads, listing uploaded files, download, delete, and managing upload permissions. The class includes methods for rendering upload list views, processing file uploads, and managing upload deletions, all following the Opencart MVC framework conventions.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Controller class for handling file uploads in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, uploading, deleting, and downloading files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the upload interface and set up the upload list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of uploaded files.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of uploads based on filters and pagination.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected uploaded files, removing associated files and database records.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles file download requests, serving upload files to users.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Processes file upload requests, validating and storing uploaded files.
